title: 跨節點累計、Shadow/Enforce 模式切換、月初重置與臨時覆寫 (Cross-Node Fair-Use, Shadow/Enforce, Monthly Reset & Temporary Override)
expected: Fair-Use policy enforces tier invariants, aggregates member usage across multiple serving exits (node & node2), transitions from shadow to enforce mode and across usage thresholds by recompiling only carrying exits, installing Tier 2 kernel tc classes on both exits, and clearing fair_use.applying from true to false once both carrying exits acknowledge the compiled generation, while ignoring duplicate/replayed events and preserving per-incarnation retained usage across node re-enrollment.
actual: Live multi-node test enrolled second exit 01a192a1-8625-70ff-84ab-6b456faffe9c (node2) and non-carrying node 01a192a2-caff-7a98-a515-14510ace90c1, routed memberA traffic across both carrying exits (aggregating 28590 bytes across 2 exits), verified shadow mode (60Mbit on node, 15Mbit on node2), proved Transition 1 (policy.activated mode=enforce: carrying gens node 7->8, node2 4->5, non-carrying 0->0; Tier 2 5Mbit/2Mbit tc classes on both exits; fair_use.applying true->false in 6325 ms via observation 01a192a2-fa98-7c96-bc72-bd86ec93a118; replay no double bump) and Transition 2 (fup.member_generation_changed via usage threshold crossing: carrying gens node 9->10, node2 6->7, non-carrying 0->0; Tier 2 5Mbit/2Mbit tc classes on both exits; fair_use.applying true->false in 49197 ms via observation 01a192a3-e791-732f-875d-c63481a63734; replay no double bump), and verified ENR-03 per-incarnation retained usage across node2 re-enrollment (01a192a1-87fc-7227-b791-9b63eb6f2b22 -> 01a192a4-2198-757b-9c0f-a60ef89735cb).

mechanism_checks.summary: Usage from Exit Node 1 (60 GB) and Exit Node 2 (55 GB) merges into one 115 GB period total crossing Tier 1 (100 GB); each exit computes its own directional rate_scope effective rate (Node 1: 25 Mbps, Node 2: 15 Mbps).

mechanism_checks.name: ShadowModeVsEnforceModeAndNodeAckSummary
mechanism_checks.summary: Shadow mode records would_apply_tier_index=1 with generation=0 and unthrottled node rates; switching to enforce mode increments generation=1 and applies Tier 1.

mechanism_checks.name: AdminOverrideExpiryAndNewMonthPeriodReset
mechanism_checks.summary: SetOverride elevates member to 100 Mbps (state=override, gen=2) until valid_until, automatically restores Tier 1 (25 Mbps, gen=3) on expiry, and resets to Tier 0 (state=normal, gen=4) at 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.
